# Change request 28 for the notes app

The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## Remove German
German is hardly used, so remove it completely.
- The `Deutsch` / `English` control is removed from `/login` and the list page.
- Every page is in English, with `lang="en"` on the `<html>` element, whatever language the browser asks for (for
  example with `Accept-Language: de`).
- Remove the German texts and the code and data for choosing a language too, not only the UI.

export type Lang = 'en' | 'de'

export const LANG_COOKIE = 'lang'

const de: Record<string, string> = {
  'Sign in': 'Anmelden',
  Name: 'Name',
  'Account deleted': 'Konto gelöscht',

  Notes: 'Notizen',

  Title: 'Titel',

  'Search button': 'Suchen',
  'You already have a note with this title': 'Du hast bereits eine Notiz mit diesem Titel',
  Edit: 'Bearbeiten',

  Pin: 'Anheften',

  'Delete account': 'Konto löschen',
  'Delete selected': 'Ausgewählte löschen',
  'Archive selected': 'Ausgewählte archivieren',
  'Load more': 'Mehr laden',
  'No notes match': 'Keine passenden Notizen',
  'Shared with me': 'Mit mir geteilt',
}

/** The page language, read from the (HttpOnly) cookie while rendering on the server and kept in state for the client. */
export function useLang() {
  return useState<Lang>('lang', () => {
    if (import.meta.client) return 'en'
    const cookie = useRequestHeaders(['cookie']).cookie ?? ''
    const match = cookie.split(';').map((part) => part.trim()).find((part) => part.startsWith(`${LANG_COOKIE}=`))
    return match?.slice(LANG_COOKIE.length + 1) === 'de' ? 'de' : 'en'
  })
}

/** Translates an English text into the current language; texts without a translation stay in English. */
export function useT() {
  const lang = useLang()
  return (text: string) => (lang.value === 'de' ? de[text] ?? text : text === 'Search button' ? 'Search' : text)
}

<script setup lang="ts">
// Posts as a plain form so switching also works without JavaScript; with JavaScript it switches in place.
const route = useRoute()
const lang = useLang()
const other = computed(() => (lang.value === 'de' ? 'en' : 'de'))
const switching = ref(false)

async function switchLang() {
  if (switching.value) return
  switching.value = true
  try {
    const { lang: next } = await $fetch<{ lang: 'en' | 'de' }>('/api/lang', { method: 'POST', body: { lang: other.value } })
    lang.value = next
  } finally {
    switching.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <form method="post" action="/api/lang" @submit.prevent="switchLang">
    <input type="hidden" name="lang" :value="other">
    <input type="hidden" name="redirect" :value="route.fullPath">
    <button
      type="submit"
      :lang="other"
      :disabled="switching"
      class="rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-indigo-700 ring-1 ring-indigo-200 hover:bg-indigo-50 disabled:opacity-60"
    >
      {{ other === 'de' ? 'Deutsch' : 'English' }}
    </button>
  </form>
</template>
